payload.description: Engineer's pre_test_requested named the command 'pytest tests/unit/test_explanations.py -v'. engineer.md gives the Engineer no information about test-runner's strict positional grammar (exactly 'python -m pytest <args>', enforced at .claude/skills/test-runner/scripts/run_command.py's validate_grammar). Submitted verbatim (unmodified) to the real test-runner Skill per the requirement to execute exactly what the Engineer requested; the wrapper returned command_rejected (grammar_no_match: executable 'pytest' is not accepted). Per test-runner/SKILL.md's explicit 'Escalation on command_rejected' instruction ('Halt the staged protocol for this task ... mark the task blocked at the orchestration layer. Never relax validation live to work around a rejection.'), the command was not silently corrected/resubmitted, and the Implementation phase is blocked here. This is a genuine, newly-discovered cross-agent contract gap: engineer.md does not document test-runner's exact command grammar requirement to the Engineer, so a live Engineer naturally requests conventional pytest CLI syntax, which the wrapper always rejects. Independently confirmed via git status/diff before this rejection that only the in-scope test file demo-repo/tests/unit/test_explanations.py was modified (real TDD Step 6 work, test_explain_includes_overall_risk_band added plus 3 existing calls updated to pass a Band argument); no production source file was changed.
